decisions.evidence: Compared the raw-hash-matching continuation preimage with the raw-hash-matching reader-post carrier. The repaired dot is the proper diagonal pushforward of a degree-two Chern cap class, of BM degree 2d_nu-2; the old diagonal ! symbol had no cohomological input type. Mixed and braid identities are now word-corner identities, with equal-color conditions and the valid braid index range. Checked looplessness, a>b arrow entries, both multiplicities, degree homogeneity and beta=0; the smooth-incidence supplier supplies properness and orientations, and the later discharged polynomial/relations claims remain in justified_by.

Accepted the reader repair after checking all seven current steps and all thirteen direct dependencies. F4 now has the real degree drop 2d. Step 1.1 correctly computes H_G(G/B)=H_T(pt), not the false polynomial extension of H_G(pt). Echelon stabilizers and closed rank filtrations give free closure-class modules; nonzero root and arrow weights give localized fixed-pair matrix units. Step 4.1 proves the necessary scalar-extension identity for dualizing coefficients before using T-module faithfulness. Step 4.2 has unique reduced chains, once-crossed labeled pairs and the monotone allowedness identity, retaining each arrow multiplicity; the triangular basis argument no longer uses the subsequent relation theorem.

The current proof derives the unequal-color common-arrow quotient and its positive tangent Euler factor, derives equal-color projective-line push-pull and the normalization -1, and checks squares, both mixed identities and all dot slides. Independently expanded the repeated-adjacent braid patterns by D_2 M_g=M_g D_2 and permutation conjugacy; the all-equal alternant and outer-equal two skew-group expansions give precisely the stated braid quotient. The two direction multiplicities remain arbitrary, including zero. The equal-color degree is correctly -2=-a_ii; faithfulness is used only after operator identities are established.

Accepted the reader canonical-coset absorption proof: the four t_j s_i identities use only far moves, braid moves and pair removals, canonical length is inversion number, and reduced words normalize without shortening. Crossing-number induction and dot/crossing inversions then give spanning by finitely many crossing words with arbitrary dot powers, whose geometric images are independent. Checked the corner Ext/BM adjunction proof and the complete product-compatibility proof, including degree shifts, source-first order, units and absence of an extra Koszul sign. Amended the surviving Statement finiteness disclaimer to the precise absence of total-Ext finite-dimensionality, matching current Proof 4.1 and the finite-type hypotheses of F4/F5.

Accepted the added PBW dependency and F3: the rank-two polynomial freeness in 1.1 is not supplied by the incidence definition, and satisfying nil-Hecke relations alone does not prove a presentation isomorphism. Current 3.1 reduces the abstract presentation to f+g tau, and its two independent geometric images supplied by PBW give injectivity and surjectivity. Checked E=0, X=P^1, d=1, Z=P^1 times P^1, standard push-pull sign, tau=-[C], D^2=0, both mixed signs and degree -2.

The pre-reader calculation is mathematically correct. Independently multiplied the color-dependent crossings in the rational skew group algebra: both authored A and B coefficients match exactly, their longest-permutation coefficients cancel, and their identity coefficients give minus the difference-of-cubes quotient with nonzero x^2 coefficient -1. Checked d_(i,j,i)=4, d_(j,i,i)=5, d_(i,i,j)=3 and normalization exponents 2,1. The reader replaced an undocumented arithmetic assertion with explicit expansions; this is audit enrichment, not a confirmed mathematical defect.

The raw-preimage page comparison shows two clarifications: the PBW basis is over the first-coordinate polynomial corners and the top coefficient comes from reduced flag chains with full arrow multiplicities. Both are consistent with the earlier and current sound claims. Checked the current Objective against all four A-item statements, characteristic-zero and finite loopless multiedge scope, source-first shifted Ext product, and the caveat restricting the paving claim to relative-position incidence strata. No mathematical page defect is identified.

Confirmed the reader and refuter citation-inaccurate finding on the same unchanged reader-post B page. Its claim that both examples depend only on the definition and relation theorem omits the PBW basis genuinely used by the equal-color example F3 and Verification 1.1/3.1. The relation theorem proves operator identities and a homomorphism, but no two-class basis or presentation isomorphism. Corrected the supporting sentence to include geometric PBW for the equal-color presentation isomorphism; the formulas and example statements are preserved.
